description: This file defines the base class OpenTypeFontTable for handling various OpenType font tables within the PDFsharp library, including cloning, preparation for compilation, writing, and checksum calculation.

classes.name: OpenTypeFontTable
classes.description: Represents a generic OpenType font table used in the PDFsharp font subsystem, providing cloning, preparation, writing, and checksum functionality.

methods.name: OpenTypeFontTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the font table with font data and a tag.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the font table instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the actual deep copy of the object, resetting the offset.

methods.name: PrepareForCompilation
methods.description: Placeholder method to prepare the font table for binary compilation, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Placeholder method to write the font table into a binary format, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: CalcChecksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for a byte array representing a font table.
